title: Frozen card: why, unfreeze it, and a refund on the frozen account
why: An urgent customer with a frozen card. The API gives no freeze reason, so the agent must not invent one, can't unfreeze, and hands off. Then the customer asks for a $40 refund that would qualify on an active card; I chose to hold refunds on frozen accounts for the person reviewing the freeze (documented in the README), and that request has to reach the person too, so the customer never repeats it. Finally 'when will it be unfrozen?' tests for an invented timeline.
turns: My card got declined at the pharmacy and the app says it's frozen. Why?? Please unfreeze it now, I need my medicine.
Ok but at least refund the $40 from Metro Pharmacy on Tuesday, txn_2001. They charged me even though the payment failed.
So when will it be unfrozen?
